messages:
zuri: Kicking off Aster LoRA onboarding into mariner-int4-lowlat. Quick smoke shows weird spacing around percent signs and parentheses, plus odd scientific notation breaks. Need a quick triage before we push to canary.
ken: oof, can you drop one failing input/output and the exact merge flags?
zuri: example: input 'Profit margin (Q4): 12.5%' -> model returns 'Profit margin ( Q4 ) : 12 . 5 %'
Also '1.2e+03' -> '1 . 2 e + 03' which breaks downstream number parsing.

Config: quant=dynamic-int4, merge-strat=stitch-zipper, token-map=vendor-aster-v1.json, token-sync applied with --keep-unknowns. kv-cache=on.
paul: that pattern screams detokenization spacing inserted by the merge tokenizer mapping or by the stitch algorithm. Did you run tokenizer-check --compare-ids?
zuri: ran tokenizer-check: majority align, but there are ~18 tokens where vendor mapping replaced single tokens with two-token sequences. embed drift negligible. Uploaded smoke artifacts.
eval-bot: smoke summary: overall pass 0.89, numeric-formatting-fail-rate=0.12, scientific-notation-fail=0.15. Full diffs: s3://redwood/aster/smoke/4181239999/diffs.zip
merge-bot: merge job record created id=merge-4181239999, provenance: stitch-zipper v0.7. Logs: https://ci.redwood/merge/4181239999
ken: plan: 1) rerun merge with token-map=generic to see if vendor map is the cause; 2) rerun stitch-zipper with collapse-numeric-tokens=true and per-layer-scale=auto; 3) run runtime with kv-cache=false to rule out KV detokenization interaction.
paul: also try quant=static-int4 as a control. If generic map fixes it, we need to regen the vendor token-map with single-token preferences.
zuri: doing the three runs now, will attach new diffs. tagging: @ken @paul :eyes:
